name: Protected Visibility
description: The ``protected`` keyword is part of the three keywords to define visibility of a method, property or constant. It is the middle level of visibility: it restricts usage to the current class, its parents and children.
code:
<?php

class Elephpant {
    public function methodY() {
        // dependency on the child class
        echo self::HABITAT;
    }
}

class AfricanElephpant extends Elephpant {
    protected const HABITAT = 1;

    public function method() {
        echo self::HABITAT;
    }
}

class Calf extends AfricanElephpant {
    public function methodY() {
        echo self::HABITAT;
    }
}

?>
